about.title: About us
content: We are a team of programmers established as a worker co-op. We design and build custom software: reliable, scalable systems aligned with each project's goals.
Collaborative work and a horizontal, democratic organization strengthen our technical and professional process, so we can deliver quality results at every stage.
We support teams and organizations with full-stack, backend, data and AI development, putting our experience behind the success of their digital products.

items.title: AI, Machine Learning, LLMs
content: We design and integrate artificial intelligence, machine learning models and LLMs into real products and processes.
From exploration and prototypes to production rollout, we help teams turn AI into concrete business value.

items.title: Data Architecture & Engineering
content: We build and implement solid data architectures: pipelines, integration, modeling and governance so information is reliable and actionable.
We help organize, transform and expose data for analytics, digital products and decision systems.

items.title: Automations
content: We automate operational and technical processes to cut manual work, errors and cycle times.
We integrate systems, orchestrate flows and design custom automations that scale with your organization.

items.title: Backend Development
content: We build robust, secure and growth-ready APIs, services and backend platforms.
We prioritize quality, maintainability and performance to support demanding digital products.

items.title: Full-stack development
content: We deliver end-to-end products: interfaces, business logic and infrastructure working as one system.
Custom engineering teams that take the product from idea through continuous evolution.

models.title: Product development
content: We take care of building your product end to end: defining the technical approach and shipping to production with clear quality standards.
We get involved with the outcome, not just the tasks, so the software evolves alongside the business.

models.title: Software consultancy
content: We look at your technology landscape to spot bottlenecks, risks and opportunities. We help you make practical decisions about architecture, stack and process.
We also support your teams with knowledge transfer, so improvements stick and remain sustainable over time.

models.title: Team augmentation
content: We embed cooperative programmers into your existing team, matching your tools and ways of working to speed delivery without adding friction.
We join the day-to-day of the project and share ownership of what gets built, supporting the team with sustained capacity as it grows.
